sn5.5:1.2: Atha kho Uppalavaṇṇā bhikkhunī pubbaṇha-samayaṃ nivāsetvā || pa ||
sn5.5:1.4: Atha kho Māro pāpimā Uppalavaṇṇāya bhikkhuniyā bhayaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃsaṃ uppādetu-kāmo samādhimhā cāvetu-kāmo yena Uppalavaṇṇā bhikkhunī tenupasaṅkami || || 3. Upasaṅkamitvā Uppalavaṇṇam bhikkhuniṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn5.5:2.4: idhāgatā tādisikā bhaveyyuṃ || bāle na tvaṃ bhāyasi dhuttakānan ti || || 4.
sn5.5:3.1: Atha kho Uppalavaṇṇāya bhikkhuniyā etad ahosi || ||
sn5.5:3.2: Ko nu khvāyam manusso vā amanusso vā gātham bhāsasīti || || 5.
sn5.5:3.3: Atha kho Uppalavaṇṇāya bhikkhuniyā etad ahosi || ||
sn5.5:3.4: Māro ayam pāpimā mama bhayaṃ || pa || gāthaṃ bhāsatīti || || 6.
sn5.5:3.5: Atha kho Uppalavaṇṇā bhikkhunī || Māro ayaṃ pāpimā iti viditvā Māram pāpimantaṃ gāthāhi paccabhāsi || ||
sn5.5:4.4: na Māra bhāyāmi tam ekikā pi || ||
sn5.5:7.1: Atha kho Māro pāpimā || jānāti mam Uppalavaṇṇā bhikkhunīti dukkhī dummano tatth-ev-antaradhāyīti || || 1. Sāvatthi nidānaṃ || ||
